documents.title: Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Communication To Shareholders
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Second Quarter And Half Year Ended On September 30, 2026.

analysis.summary: Management discussed Q1 FY27 results, noting that profits were significantly higher, driven by better realizations despite a war-like situation causing input cost increases and plant shutdowns. Several non-operational plants in acetic acid, ethyl acetate, and TDI have resumed operations in July and August. Management provided details on ongoing capex projects, raw material production numbers, and cost-saving initiatives supported by consultants like A.T. Kearney. Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY 26-27, reporting financial performance details including segment revenues and feedstock spreads.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that globally TDI production is quite high against demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall globally TDI production is quite high against the demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that there is a shortage of TDI in the Indian market which affects pricing.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes, there is a shortage in the Indian market of TDI that will definitely affect the pricing.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for ammonium nitrate is supported by a 6% to 7% CAGR.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as the ammonium nitrate is concerned, CAGR is around 6% to 7%.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that out of four ongoing projects, the overdue project of Dahej has started producing.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to the projects, the -- out of the 4 ongoing projects, the overdue project of Dahej has started producing now.

capex_expansion.claim: Management mentioned that capex incurred in Q1 was INR300 crores in CWIP.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex incurred was INR300 crores in CWIP.

capex_expansion.claim: Projects under consideration include BisPhenol-A (BPA) at Dahej (150 KTPA), Polyols at Dahej (100 KTPA), and Acetic Acid at Bharuch (350 KTPA).
capex_expansion.quote:
1. BisPhenol-A (BPA) – Dahej 150 KTPA
2. Polyols – Dahej 100 KTPA
3. Acetic Acid - Bharuch 350 KTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The coal-based CCPP is targeted for synchronization in the third week of June and performance guarantee test run in the third week of August 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The coal-based CCPP, as we call it in our presentation was to start sometime in April, but the lump sum turnkey contractor faced certain delays and they have revised the date now for synchronization sometime in the third week of June. And for the performance guarantee test run to make it available on a full steam basis, it is sometime in the third week of August '26.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex for FY27 is estimated to be around INR 2,800 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex for FY27 is going to be around INR 2,800 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Projects including ammonia expansion, weak nitric acid, and ammonium nitrate melt are scheduled to come up next year.
capex_expansion.quote: All the three-ammonia expansion, the nitric acid, ammonium nitrate melt, all are going to come up by next year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is discussing licensing for additional capacity with INEOS instead of the earlier planned joint venture.
capex_expansion.quote: For the capex, there is an update which we have covered in the investor presentation that we had earlier plan of JV with INEOS. Now we are talking to them about licensing for additional capacity.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that energy norms for urea were revised from 6.20 Gcal per metric ton to 6.37 Gcal.
margins_costs.quote: It was 6.20 Gcal per metric ton of urea, which is revised to 6.37 Gcal now.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that the steam portion of the Dahej project provides substantial relief to the cost position of the TDI-II plant.
margins_costs.quote: Out of the steam and power, the steam portion has started coming, which is giving substantial relief in terms of the better cost position to TDI-II plant.

margins_costs.claim: During Q-o-Q Q1, the result decreased mainly due to higher input cost and fixed cost partially offset by better realization.
margins_costs.quote: Result is decreased mainly due to higher input cost and fixed cost partially offset by better realization.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that the Coal Based Steam & Power Plant is expected to improve the operating margins of TDI II.
margins_costs.quote: • Coal Based Steam & Power Plant: Expected to improve the operating margins of TDI II.

margins_costs.claim: On a sequential quarter basis, there is a net reduction of INR 3,000 per metric ton in oil prices.
margins_costs.quote: There is a net reduction of INR 3,000 on a sequential quarter basis on a per metric ton sequential quarter basis.

margins_costs.claim: Product price realizations in chemicals saw increases ranging from 6% to 28% compared to the previous quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Product to product, but if you see the range, it is from 6% to 28%.

margins_costs.claim: Methanol production was not viable during the period due to very high gas prices.
margins_costs.quote: Whereas in case of methanol, the cost economics did not work out given the very high gas price.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported ammonia production was approximately 173,000 with 54% from oil and 49% from gas.
orders_capacity.quote: Ammonia production was approximately 173,000 and 54% out of that was from oil and 49% was from gas.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported total TDI production of 12,800 with 66% from Dahej and 34% from Bharuch.
orders_capacity.quote: So TDI total production was 12,800 a breakup of 66% from Dahej unit and 34% from Bharuch unit.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that except for ANP, acetic, ethyl, and TDI which were shut during part of the quarter, all other plants operated beyond rated capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: I will say that except ANP, acetic and Ethyl and TDI which were shut during part of the quarter. Rest all the plants have operated beyond the rated capacity, whether it is ammonia, urea, both with nitric acid.

orders_capacity.claim: Ammonia oil route production was close to 300,000 metric tons and gas route was 360,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Ammonia oil route was close to 3 lakh metric ton. Gas route was 360,000.

orders_capacity.claim: Technical grade urea production exceeded 210,000 tons in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: We produced more than 210,000 in FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: TDI plant capacity utilization is close to 80%.
orders_capacity.quote: So far as TDI is concerned, it is close to 80%.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated cash on hand in the books is around INR4,000 crores.
Management stated cash on hand is a mix across G-Sec, GSFS, and banks.
capital_allocation.quote: It's a mix, yes. It's a mix across 3 things: G-Sec, GSFS and bank.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated full year capex target is another INR1,200 crores to INR1,500 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Targeted for the full year is another INR1,200 crores to INR1,500 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared a dividend of 210%, amounting to INR 21 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Considering all this, Board has in general declared a dividend of 210%. This is INR21 per share, which is historically the second highest dividend in its history of 50 years.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that during the first quarter, war escalation and deescalation created viability issues and higher realizations and input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Overall, during the quarter 1, it has been the situation of escalation and deescalation as far as war is concerned. And that has a ripple effect on the business as well, in terms of, at times, viability issues, at times, realizations, which have gone up. Similarly, the input costs have also gone up because of the war situation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated certain plants like acetic acid, ethyl acetate, and TDI could not run for cost economics reasons during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: During this quarter gone by, there are plants which we could not run for cost economics reason, like acetic acid, ethyl acetate and to some extent, TDI as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: The continuing war has changed the equation of value addition as in some cases, there is adverse divergence between feed cost and final output realisation.
risks_headwinds.quote: The continuing war has change the equation of value addition as in some cases, there is adverse divergence between feed cost and final output realisation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Company continues to closely monitor geopolitical developments and are proactively taking necessary actions to safeguard interest of all Stakeholders.
risks_headwinds.quote: Company continues to closely monitor geopolitical developments and are proactively taking necessary actions to safeguard interest of all Stakeholders.

risks_headwinds.claim: War-related logistics disruptions impacted urea volumes and created volatility in raw material availability and pricing.
risks_headwinds.quote: In view of the war, there was disruption in the logistics where the company came forward and supported on this.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fixed cost and energy norm revisions for urea are overdue, widening losses in the fertilizer segment.
risks_headwinds.quote: In case of fertilizer, the revision both in urea of fixed cost as well as energy norms are yet to happen. And this is overdue as the losses are widening in case of Fertilizer segment.

risks_headwinds.claim: Aniline margins face severe pressure from cheap Chinese imports and dumping.
risks_headwinds.quote: And there is an import dumping in the market, which I will ask Tejas to cover. And basically, on a stand-alone, we are not viable in aniline.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated the energy norms revision for urea is valid for a 3-year period starting from FY25-26.
management_commitments.quote: This has been revised for a period from FY25-26, and valid for 3 years period.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated power from the Dahej project is expected to come in a month or 45 days.
management_commitments.quote: And power, we are expecting to come in a month's time or so or around 45 days' time.

management_commitments.claim: As a matter of policy, management stated they do not provide any forecast about the future business situation.
management_commitments.quote: As a matter of policy, we do not provide any forecast about the future business situation.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they do not comment or give guidance on future results or business outlook.
management_commitments.quote: We do not comment or give guidance on future results or business outlook.

management_commitments.claim: The coal-based CCPP is targeted for synchronization in the third week of June 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The coal-based CCPP, as we call it in our presentation was to start sometime in April, but the lump sum turnkey contractor faced certain delays and they have revised the date now for synchronization sometime in the third week of June.

management_commitments.claim: Performance guarantee test run for the CCPP to make it available on a full steam basis is planned for the third week of August 2026.
management_commitments.quote: And for the performance guarantee test run to make it available on a full steam basis, it is sometime in the third week of August '26.

management_commitments.claim: New projects identification will have clarity by the end of calendar year 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The new projects identification will have clarity by end of this calendar year for taking it to the investment table-grade decisions.

management_commitments.claim: A planned shutdown is scheduled for April 2027.
management_commitments.quote: We have a planned shutdown in April '27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
